title: Pool, Central and Sheung Wan, big night out
call: The windiest, cloudiest day, which is why Plan B moved the Peak and the cable car off it. Mostly cloudy, a few light rain patches early, sunny intervals later, 25 to 28°, east force 4 to 5. The street-level afternoon in Central and Sheung Wan suits it, and the Star Ferry will be a little choppy. Pool is cool in the wind.
